title: Pneumatic tire with double-layer tread
abstract: The present invention relates to a pneumatic tire comprising a carcass and a tread, the tread being located radially outward of the carcass and extending between tire sidewalls; the tread providing a radially outermost tread running surface; the tread comprises a first tread layer comprising a first compound and a second tread layer comprising a second compound; wherein the second tread layer is positioned radially adjacent to the first tread layer; wherein the first compound is compositionally different from the second compound; wherein the second tread layer comprises one or more integrally formed extensions of the second tread layer extending radially outward of the tread cap; wherein each integrally formed extension of the second tread layer comprises a circumferentially continuous groove and a reinforced region disposed on a side of the groove.
